name: Permanent Satellite Tower
placementTarget: On the board, next to a city that had a satellite tower in the just-played game.
text: No words. A yellow square with a dark blue circle and a yellow satellite dish emitting three signal arcs.

mechanics.timing: Game end, when spending production units on upgrades. The cost 3 is the orange circle printed beside each of these stickers on the Game End Upgrades sheet (P7-22a). The words "production units" are not printed on this sticker.
mechanics.effect: Put this sticker next to a city that had a satellite tower in the just-played game. During later setup, add a satellite tower to each city with a Permanent Satellite Tower sticker.
restrictions: Four stickers. Only a city that had a satellite tower in the game just played.
The sheet that holds them is sticker-02, printed P7-22a.
